text:
jane.acme: Hey team — after our IdP cleanup this morning a few of our org admins suddenly see all project action buttons grayed out in the console (Create Project / Invite / Billing). They were admins before. No UI errors, just 403 on actions. Ticket #SUP-2379 opened via support-bot.
support-bot: Ticket SUP-2379 created and linked to this thread — priority P1.
alex.support: Thanks, Jane — can you confirm whether affected users authenticate via SSO (Okta) only or have fallback API keys? Also any recent SCIM group changes?
jane.acme: All SSO (Okta). We did a group prune where we deleted some unused groups and renamed others. No API key usage for these admin users.
mira.sre: Can you share the 403 repro (curl or browser devtools)? We want the response payload and the auth token header if possible (redact sensitive bits).
jane.acme: Repro steps I used: 1) Login via SSO -> redirected to console 2) Click on org "Acme Corp" > Settings 3) Click "Invite" -> button disabled, console sends POST to /api/orgs/123/invite and returns 403. From chrome devtools network:
Request: POST /api/orgs/123/invite
Authorization: Bearer eyJ...REDACTED...
Response: 403 {"error":"forbidden","reason":"missing:roles/org_admin"}
alex.support: That reason string is helpful — implies the token lacks org_admin role claim. Can you paste masked decoded JWT claims? (only claim names/values, redact sub/exp)
jane.acme: Decoded claims (redacted): {
  "iss": "https://acme.okta.com",
  "email": "jane@acme.com",
  "groups": ["engineering","acme-owners"],
  "roles": ["project_viewer"]
}
We lost the roles/org_admin claim. The "acme-owners" SCIM group should map to org_admins in Redwood.
mira.sre: Looks like SCIM mapping broke during the prune/rename. Okta probably removed or renamed the group id; SCIM resync may not have propagated. Two action items: (1) quick remediation to restore console actions for org admins, (2) permanent fix for group->role mapping backfill.
Quick remediation — temporary workaround: add a complementary org admin role via the CLI admin API using a service token (requires org owner or support action). Example curl (run from your infra):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/123/roles \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"user_email":"jane@acme.com","role":"org_admin"}'
```
This will restore UI buttons immediately.
iv an.eng-infra: @mira.sre fyi, we saw a SCIM delta job fail around 2026-03-18T08:12Z with a mapping error on group rename. Job id scim-delta-7654. The group rename created a temporary orphan mapping (old group id removed, new group not yet mapped). I'll re-run a targeted resync for Acme.
ivan.eng-infra: Running targeted resync now: `scimctl resync --org 123 --job scim-delta-7654`
ivan.eng-infra: Resync completed — delta applied, mapping restored for group "acme-owners" -> role org_admin. Please re-login or clear session to pick up new token.
jane.acme: After resync I logged out/in and the buttons are back! Thanks. One follow-up — how can we avoid this on future group renames? We rename groups as part of housekeeping.
olivia.prodops: Two recommendations: (1) enable SCIM atomic rename handling (feature flag) so group renames retain mapping via alias instead of deleting+creating, (2) add a pre-prune check in Okta to warn if mapping exists in Redwood (we can surface group->role references in the admin UI). We'll propose the flag to product.
alex.support: For the support ticket notes: root cause = SCIM group rename led to mapping orphan; token claims lacked org_admin role; console actions returned 403. Remediation = targeted SCIM resync + temporary role patch via admin API. Preventative = enable atomic rename, add pre-prune warning, and a backfill job that re-assigns roles when SCIM renames detected.
jane.acme: Appreciate the cadence. Please add details to the ticket for our compliance audit.
ivan.eng-infra: Pushed a lightweight backfill job to run nightly for 72 hours for org 123 to repair any transient orphans. Job id backfill-123-20260318.
mira.sre: Marking this thread resolved for now, keeping ticket open until backfill window closes. If anyone else sees a similar issue ping #eng-infra. :white_check_mark:
